V1 drops flexibility and stress benefits; V2 drops energy and the machines' technology/comfort benefits; V3 drops all those benefits; V6 drops flexibility.

V5 does that and removes the records qualifier. V1 and V6 omit the explicit relationship acknowledgment; V6 also uses an unnatural Chilean currency format.
